tns:patch.keyword: fix null index column in amp_structure_coordinate
tns:patch.author: brianbrix
tns:patch.description: Backfill null index values in amp_structure_coordinate caused by inverse=true on the Hibernate list mapping never writing the index column. Now that the mapping uses a bag, the column is no longer read, but this patch keeps the data clean.

script.lang: UPDATE amp_structure_coordinate SET index = (v.row_number - 1) FROM ( SELECT amp_structure_coordinate_id, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY amp_structure_id ORDER BY amp_structure_coordinate_id) FROM amp_structure_coordinate WHERE index IS NULL ) v WHERE v.amp_structure_coordinate_id = amp_structure_coordinate.amp_structure_coordinate_id
